description: Chef Lethrow, not satisfied with your last collection of ingredients, sends you out into the Forest of the Green Lady. This time to find the legendary Red Truffle, a mushroom which he hopes, will elevate the Bishop’s dish beyond all expectation.
name: A Demanding Chef II (MSQ)
completed: You've gathered what you need, now hurry back to Chef Lethrow to make sure there is time before the festival.
